description: Run on a PE primary to emergency-revoke a compiler's Intermediate CA (POST .../revoke), splicing its serial into the root CRL and invalidating every agent certificate it signed. Fails if the response reports crl-updated: false. Requires an RBAC token (certificate_authority:sign_ica) since this route has no certname allowance.

compiler_fqdn.description: Certname/FQDN of the compiler whose Intermediate CA to revoke.

token_file.description: Path to an RBAC token file granting certificate_authority:sign_ica. Defaults to ~/.puppetlabs/token (the file `puppet access login` writes).
